title: Rivian puts Doug Field in charge of Mind Robotics
teaser: Rivian has named Doug Field, Ford’s former head of electric vehicles, president of Mind Robotics, the industrial robotics company spun out of the automaker. Field will lead product, engineering and operations while Rivian founder RJ Scaringe remains involved. The hire gives Mind Robotics an operator with experience at Ford, Apple and Tesla—and puts him in charge of a company whose first factory floor will be Rivian’s own.
